title: MuseRank Webhook Payload
description: Schema for the JSON body POSTed by MuseRank to a configured webhook endpoint. Mirrors the TypeScript `WebhookPayload` exported by @muserank/webhook-sdk; if you change one, change the other (CI checks they stay in sync).

event_id.description: Stable identifier for the event (NOT the delivery attempt). Use as your idempotency key. Same event_id is sent on every retry of the same event.

delivery_id.description: Optional per-attempt delivery identifier. Changes on every retry. Use for cross-referencing receiver logs with MuseRank's outbound logs, NOT for idempotency.

timestamp.description: ISO 8601 timestamp marking when MuseRank sent this delivery attempt.

title.description: SEO-optimized title when set, falling back to the editorial title.

content_markdown.description: Markdown form of the article. Empty string when the article has no content yet.

content_html.description: Raw editor HTML, exactly as authored in MuseRank.

meta_description.description: SEO meta description. Empty string when none was set.

image_url.description: Featured image URL. Empty string when none was set.

slug.description: URL-friendly slug derived from the article title.

tags.description: Primary keyword + SEO focus keyphrase + topical-map siblings, deduped case-insensitively. tags[0] is always the primary keyword.
